title: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Grape Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Grape combines the juicy, sun-ripened sweetness of Mango with the bold, full-bodied flavour of dark Grape. The mango brings a smooth, tropical richness, while the grape adds a slightly tangy, deep fruitiness that lingers on the exhale, creating a well-rounded and satisfying vape. With its 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, delivering a smooth throat hit with full-bodied flavour. Ideal for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying experience. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Moreish Puff Manju Man Nic Salts offer a convenient way to enjoy rich and layered fruit flavours in a compact format.
